deadline.value: UC Doctoral Scholarships, open to any discipline, close 15 May 2027 for a second-half 2027 start. The PhD itself has no stated closing date.
deadline.quote: for students planning to start in the second half of 2027; opens 20 March, closes 15 May

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the official pages checked for this PhD.

supervisor.value: You must contact a potential supervisor before applying, and written evidence of their agreement must be included in the myUC application.
supervisor.quote: PhD students must contact a potential supervisor before applying.

also.quote: This evidence of supervision must be included in your application in myUC for your application to be assessed.

funding.value: UC doctoral funding is scholarship-based and applied for in rounds, and some projects have no funding, so it is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Two application rounds each year, the first closing in May and the second in October.

also.quote: It will also state if the project is funded (i.e. has a scholarship covering fees or a stipend or both, or none).

entry_route.value: A research-focused honours or master's degree at First or Second Class Division I level is needed, so both routes are accepted.
entry_route.quote: Enrolment in a PhD requires completion of a research-focused honours or master’s degree, at First or Second Class (Division I) Honours or Distinction level (or equivalent qualifications).

notes: Earthquake Engineering, Fire Engineering and Transportation Engineering are separate official PhD subjects and are not mapped here.
